pending_ops.s_max_i32: enabled only when calibration.json m1_controls.smax_i32_eq_scc1 and m1_controls.smax_i32_gt_scc0 are both PASS on the campaign's device, and config subset.enable_pending_if_calibrated lists it
pending_ops.s_getreg_b32: enabled only when every m2_controls entry (C1-C9, candidate and twin form) in the campaign's calibration.json is PASS on the campaign's device, the existing fenced MODE op probe AGREES, and config subset.enable_pending_if_calibrated lists it

mode_forms.s_setreg_imm32_b32: hwreg(HW_REG_WAVE_MODE, 0|4, 4), imm (0 <= imm <= 0xF: immediate limited to the 4-bit field)
mode_forms.not_supported: VGPR_MSB, FP16_OVFL, SCALAR_PREFETCH_EN, REPLAY_MODE, FLAT_SCRATCH_IS_NV, DISABLE_PERF, any other hwreg or bit range, hwreg aliases (HW_REG_MODE, numeric ids), s_set_vgpr_msb

verifier_extra_wait_alu_encodings.0xfffe: literal encoding with only SA_SDST==0; accepted by the verifier, never emitted by the fuzzer

required_waits.P-GETREG-MODE-THEN-MODE-WRITE: a MODE write (s_setreg_b32, s_setreg_imm32_b32, s_round_mode, s_denorm_mode) after s_getreg_b32 MODE with no s_wait_alu whose SA_SDST field is 0 (all | sa_sdst) between them is outside the profile (mode_order UNKNOWN); generation inserts that wait

control_programs.seeds/mode_read.json: a MODE read -> ROUND_MODE sequence without an SA_SDST wait: CPU control (mode_order UNKNOWN), never a seed, never on the GPU

wrapper_forms: s_mov_b32 sN, <canary literal>   (N in s4..s15, not named by the body)
v_mov_b32 vN, <canary literal>   (N in VGPR pool, not named by the body)
v_mov_b32 vT, sN   (vT = OUT_TEMPS[k], v10..v17; k = store slot index)

control_only_ops.s_cmp_eq_u32: only in role=control requests (signed S_MAX SCC presets); never in generated bodies

allowlist_canonical: sha256 of json.dumps({'body','pending','wrapper','control_only'} sorted lists, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True)
